name: Power Attack
description: Spend 2 minor actions in the same turn to deal +1 damage die on all melee attacks.

name: Mighty Strikes
description: Take -1 on melee attacks to gain +1 damage (+2 for 2-handed weapons). Scales every 4 levels.

name: Rapid Strike
description: Take -2 penalty to melee attack roll to deal +1 die of damage.

name: Cleave
description: As an all-out action, make a single melee attack against a target and any targets adjacent to both.

name: Whirlwind Attack
description: When using Cleave, hit all creatures adjacent to you (or 2 squares away with reach).

name: Dodge
description: Once per turn as a reaction, make an Acrobatics check to avoid an attack that beat your Reflex.

name: Dodge Roll
description: Whenever you successfully dodge an attack, immediately move 1 square without provoking counterattacks.

name: Dual Wield I
description: Reduces the two-weapon attack penalty from -10 to -5.

name: Dual Wield II
description: Reduces the two-weapon attack penalty from -5 to -2.

name: Dual Wield III
description: Take no penalty when attacking with 2 weapons.

name: Precise Shot
description: Make ranged attacks into melee without suffering the standard -5 penalty.

name: Rapid Shot
description: Take -2 on ranged attacks to deal +1 die of damage (uses 2 ammo).

name: Shield Bash
description: Make counterattacks with your shield (Tiny 1d4, Small 1d6, Med 1d8, Large 1d10).

name: Threshold Up
description: Gain +5 bonus to your Break Threshold.

name: Channel
description: Once per day when <= 1/2 MP, spend a minor action to restore MP equal to Mind score or 1/4 max MP.

name: Arcane Study
description: Learn a number of spells equal to 1 + Int modifier from scrolls.

name: Bardic Study
description: Learn a number of performances equal to 1 + Int modifier from scores.

name: Burnout
description: Move twice your base speed in a single secondary action, then move -1 step on the Break Gauge.

name: Cannoneer
description: Reroll ranged attacks made with an airship artillery piece, keeping the second result.

name: Cooperative
description: When aiding another, the bonus provided increases to +5 rather than +2.

name: Coordinated Attack
description: Aided ally deals +1 damage die per 5 points their attack beats target Reflex (max 5 dice).

name: Crippling Attack
description: Reduce target speed by 1 square per exploding melee damage die (minimum 2 squares).

name: Dynamism
description: Substitute Charisma modifier in place of Mind modifier when calculating Will Defence.

name: Fight or Flight
description: Substitute a reactionary attack to move up to half speed without provoking.

name: First Strike
description: Add your full level instead of half level to attack rolls against targets that have not acted.

name: Hit and Run
description: Gain +2 squares of movement when using Running Attack.

name: Hold Together
description: Minor action when piloted vehicle is below half HP: grant temporary HP equal to 1/4 max HP.

name: Mad Charge
description: Free Persuasion check during a charge to intimidate targets and adjacent enemies, causing flat-footed.

name: Mantra
description: Once per day, use the Channel technick as a free action.

name: No Honour
description: Gain +2 Stealth per status effect on target when stealing (max +10).

name: No-nonsense
description: +5 bonus to Will Defence against Deception, Persuasion, and Performance checks.

name: Reposition
description: Move 1 square without provoking after hitting with a reactionary attack.

name: Salvage
description: 25% to 100% chance to recover a Trap Kit when successfully disarming traps.

name: Stagger
description: Move target 1 square per exploding melee damage die (max 2 squares).

name: Stubborn
description: Once per encounter, gain resistance (or turn resistance to immunity) against incoming damage, then move -1 step on Break Gauge.

name: Sucker Punch
description: Knock target prone if surprise melee attack beats both Ref and Fort defence.

name: Unflinching
description: Gain a temporary Hero Point whenever a fear or mind effect fails to affect you.

name: Visceral Strike
description: Reroll the lowest damage die on melee attacks that roll 2 or more dice.
